messages:
pagerduty-bot: PAGER — Sev 2: network degradation detected in us-east-3 (AZ3). Multiple errors observed across API endpoints, several customer reports of timeouts. Paging on-call.

mira: I'm on it. Observed spike in 502s and TLS read timeouts starting ~10m ago. Seems concentrated for IPv6 client connections. Repro: `curl -6 -v https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate` stalls after TLS handshake.

cheng: I see BGP updates to the AZ3 egress peer ~12m ago. Also seeing ICMP "Fragmentation needed" messages dropped on the transit path. Suspect PMTUD failure with mismatched MTU (9000 <-> 1500) on some links.

sara: Captured tcpdump showing DF bit set and no ICMP type 3/code 4 replies. Sample filter used: `tcpdump -n -i eth0 icmp or host <client-ip>`.

mira: Quick mitigation: enabling IPv4-preferred on the api load balancer for us-east-3 to force v4 for affected traffic. Rolling canary 10%.

deploy-bot: deploy started mira/force-ipv4-pref on lb/us-east-3 -> canary 10% :rocket:

mira: Canary looks promising — error rate for the canary drops ~70% for affected flows. Good signal.

cheng: Contacted cloud provider. They confirm some transit firewalls were blocking ICMP "fragmentation needed". They're enabling ICMP and adding MSS clamping at their egress NAT to 1420. ETA ~12m.

support_jess: Customer impact: ~18 open tickets, mostly embeddings/batch jobs timing out. Impacted customers are ~12% of traffic in region. No data loss, mostly request failures/timeouts.

sara: Runbook mitigation applied on our side as well: adding MSS clamp on NATs:
```
iptables -t mangle -A POSTROUTING -p tcp --tcp-flags SYN,RST SYN -j TCPMSS --clamp-mss-to-pmtu
```
This helps until PMTUD is healthy.

cheng: Also flipped dualstack preference to prefer IPv4: `dualstack_preference: ipv4` on LB config for us-east-3. Will revert when provider confirms MTU normalization.

pagerduty-bot: NOTE — escalation to Sev1 if >30% traffic impacted or >30min unresolved. Current: ~12% traffic affected, within Sev2.

mira: Handoff to cheng for monitoring and provider follow-up. I'll remain available as advisor. :wave:

cheng: Filed ticket with provider (#238172). They're normalizing MTU and confirming ICMP unblocking. Adding extra tracing for route selection + enabling verbose logs for dualstack decisions.

sara: Post-incident items: collect full packet captures, LB dualstack policy history, provider change diff, and customer timeline. Root cause hypothesis: egress path MTU mismatch combined with dropped ICMP causing PMTUD failure, amplified by LB policy preferring IPv6.

mira: TL;DR — mitigations in place (ipv4-prefer, MSS clamp, provider ICMP enable). Error rates back near baseline; monitoring for stability. Preparing RCA draft and customer comms.

support_jess: Draft customer note ready. Excerpt: "We experienced connectivity issues for IPv6 clients in us-east-3 due to MTU mismatch and blocked ICMP which prevented path MTU discovery. We applied mitigation (forced IPv4 preference and MSS clamping) and the provider enabled ICMP. No customer data lost."

deploy-bot: deploy mira/force-ipv4-pref rolled to 100% on lb/us-east-3 :white_check_mark:

cheng: Final check — error rates normalized. Will keep monitoring for 30m then close. Marking incident for postmortem and follow-up with provider for a permanent fix.

mira: Thanks team. Adding action items: provider SLA review, LB dualstack policy guardrails (auto-fallback on PMTUD failures), alert for ICMP drops on transit.

support_jess: I'll send customer updates and tag affected accounts. Closing update in 30m if stable. :email:

pagerduty-bot: Incident status: mitigation applied, monitoring. Next automated status in 20m.
